summary.intent: Create executable PLAN.md files for Phase 41 (package and app versioning and release cycles) using the GSD plan-phase workflow, including research, planning, and verification stages.
summary.outcome: Research completed inline (after agent 529 failures) and committed. Planner succeeded on retry, producing 5 plan files. Verification found 1 blocker and the session ended mid-revision loop (iteration 1/3).

repo: Phase 41 covers package and app versioning/release cycles — involves Release Please config, GitHub Actions workflows, pnpm workspace, and Rust/Cargo workspace
The project uses release-please with a manifest file (.release-please-manifest.json) and config (release-please-config.json)
There are dedicated GitHub Actions workflows: release-please.yml, deploy-staging.yml, release-gate.yml
The project is a monorepo with both JS (pnpm workspace) and Rust (Cargo workspace) components, plus a Tauri desktop app
Phase 41 CONTEXT.md contained ~40 decisions and was detailed enough to write research inline without a dedicated agent

code.finding: Contains ~40 decisions; highly detailed spec sufficient for inline research without spawning a researcher agent
Written inline by orchestrator after researcher agent was killed due to 529s; committed to repo
Read as part of researching the Tauri desktop app versioning context

workflow: When subagents hit persistent 529s, the orchestrator can recover by doing the work inline in the main context — research was written directly rather than via agent
Waiting a few minutes between 529 failures before retrying agent spawns can be effective — the planner succeeded on retry after a short wait
The GSD plan-phase workflow has a 3-iteration verification loop; plans that fail checker go back to the planner for targeted revision
TaskStop tool is used to kill stuck background agents before proceeding with inline recovery
The Nyquist validation step can be skipped when recovering from failures to avoid further ceremony overhead

friction: Anthropic API 529 overload errors caused the researcher agent to get stuck and eventually be killed
The planner agent also initially failed with a 529 before succeeding on retry after a wait
The task notification for the killed researcher agent arrived late, creating minor confusion
Nyquist validation step was skipped/interrupted mid-recovery, indicating some workflow gates were bypassed under pressure
open_items: Plan revision loop was in progress at session end (iteration 1/3) — 1 blocker from plan checker still needs resolution
5 plan files were created but not yet verified to pass — checker found 1 blocker, 2 warnings, 3 info items
The revision agent was spawned but the transcript ends before its result — unknown if it resolved the blocker
